text: ここには　なにも　いないようだ……

structure.jp: なにも　いないようだ……

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ at the end says 'it seems that', a guess from what you notice. いないようだ = 'it seems there isn't any'.

patterns.name: なにも〜ない
patterns.explanation: なにも together with a 'not' verb means 'nothing at all'. なにも　いない = 'there is nothing (no creature) here'.
